rubrics.title: Q1 2025 retained earnings roll forward
rubrics.criterion: The Q1 2025 retained-earnings roll-forward reconciles with no unexplained residual: opening retained earnings of 109 plus WTW-attributable income of 235, less dividends declared of 93 and repurchases of 200, equals the closing balance of 51.
rubrics.pass_condition: The Q1 2025 movement record reconciles 235 of WTW-attributable income less 93 of dividends and 200 of repurchases to the balance change of -58, and the retained earnings history shows 109 at 2024-12-31 and 51 at 2025-03-31.

evidence_materials.supported_claim: The Q1 2025 comparative column of the equity statement shows retained earnings of 109 at December 31, 2024 moving to 51 at March 31, 2025 through income of 235, dividends of 93 and repurchases of 200.
The 10-K equity statement shows retained earnings of 109 at December 31, 2024.

judge.expected_reasoning: The roll-forward must use net income attributable to WTW of 235 rather than consolidated net income of 239, and dividends plus repurchases must exactly account for the closing-minus-opening change of -58 with no residual.

rubrics.criterion: The Q1 2026 retained-earnings roll-forward reconciles with no unexplained residual: the opening deficit of -296 plus WTW-attributable income of 297, less dividends declared of 93 and repurchases of 300, equals the closing deficit of -392.
rubrics.pass_condition: The Q1 2026 movement record reconciles 297 of WTW-attributable income less 93 of dividends and 300 of repurchases to the balance change of -96, and the retained earnings history shows -296 at 2025-12-31 and -392 at 2026-03-31.

evidence_materials.supported_claim: The Q1 2026 column of the equity statement shows the accumulated deficit moving from -296 at December 31, 2025 to -392 at March 31, 2026 through income of 297, dividends of 93 and repurchases of 300.
The 10-K equity statement shows the accumulated deficit of -296 at December 31, 2025.

judge.expected_reasoning: Attributable income of 297 less 93 dividends and 300 repurchases equals the -96 balance change; substituting consolidated income of 303 would leave a spurious residual.

rubrics.title: Q2 2026 retained earnings roll forward
rubrics.criterion: The Q2 2026 retained-earnings roll-forward reconciles with no unexplained residual: the opening deficit of -392 plus WTW-attributable income of 229, less a net non-income movement of 536, equals the closing deficit of -699.
rubrics.pass_condition: The Q2 2026 movement record reconciles 229 of WTW-attributable income less a net non-income movement of 536 to the balance change of -307, the 536 movement is attributed to disclosed dividends of 86 plus repurchases of 450 rather than repurchases alone, and the retained earnings history shows -392 at 2026-03-31 and -699 at 2026-06-30.

evidence_materials.supported_claim: The six-month equity statement shows the accumulated deficit moving from -392 at March 31, 2026 to -699 at June 30, 2026 through income of 229, dividends of 86 and repurchases of 450.

judge.expected_reasoning: The 536 net non-income movement comprises disclosed dividends of 86 plus repurchases of 450, so attributing the whole 536 to repurchases is wrong; 229 less 536 equals the -307 balance change.
